channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill three as Zelenskyy in US for UN summit
item.description: Overnight missile and drone attacks hit several Ukrainian regions as world leaders gather in New York, US.

item.title: Iran’s Pezeshkian meets Pakistan’s Naqvi in Tehran as tensions with US rise
item.description: Pakistani interior minister's trip to Tehran is his sixth and comes as Islamabad, Doha seek to revive diplomacy with US.

item.title: G7 foreign ministers demand Houthis halt strikes on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Ministers demand an end to maritime shipping attacks and urge Iran to stop arming the Yemeni group.

item.title: Why does the US want to send Israel 40,000 bombs?
item.description: Is the planned $2.8bn US arms deal proportionate to Israel’s threat, or could it cause more civilian casualties in Gaza?

item.title: Houthis battle for strategic heights in Yemen as thousands more flee homes
item.description: Fighting intensifies as US media say Trump called off attacks against Houthis at the last minute on Sunday.

item.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may be ‘crimes against humanity’, UN says
item.description: UN expert says US forces have killed 223 people in 68 attacks in the Caribbean and the Pacific in the past year.

item.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

item.title: Sri Lankan court to deliver verdict on deadly Easter bombings
item.description: Co-ordinated suicide attacks killed 270 people across several churches and hotels in Colombo in 2019.

item.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
item.description: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.
